interpretation.future_levels: Conditional CMIP6 scenario trajectories, not deterministic forecasts.
interpretation.exposure_area: Area of newly exposed pixels only within the spatially supported part of the coastal domain. It is NOT total lake-wide exposed area.
interpretation.unknown: Pixels without sufficient spatial support. They must remain unknown and must not be treated as land or water in downstream analyses.
interpretation.deep_bathymetry: The poor shallow-coast alignment does not imply that the entire deep AMSCLAE bathymetry is invalid. The limitation applies primarily to exact shoreline positioning in poorly supported shallow zones.

limitations: Only 27.64% of the evaluated coastal domain has direct or locally supported spatial thresholds.
The 6.7992 km2 classified as unknown are not predicted.
The observed direct shoreline relation is supported only over the 2024-2026 exact Sentinel/NASA range 1552.450-1554.050 m.
AMSCLAE is used for shoreline extrapolation only in the small subset accepted by the local compatibility audit.
These products must not be represented as a continuous deterministic future shoreline around the whole lake.
